• They are never backed up to the cloud or sent to Scam Shield.

• You can delete everything at any time from your profile.

Keeps watching bank SMS alerts in the background, even when the app is closed, to spot task and job scams early. SMS text never leaves the phone.

Before you pay, tells Scam Shield when something risky happens: a scam message type, a long call from someone unknown, a new screen-sharing app or an app from outside the Play Store. Only the kind of warning is sent, never your messages, calls or contacts.
Checks new WhatsApp, Telegram and similar chat notifications for scam scripts, on this phone, and warns you. The text is never stored or sent.
Share suspicious accounts to protect you and others
When your money alerts look like a scam, sends only the accounts involved (at most 10) so Scam Shield can check them. Never your SMS or full history.

You received %1$s from %2$d unknown accounts and then paid %3$s to %4$d new people, each time more. This is how task scams work. Stop before paying more.

1. Small “rewards” arrive from strangers for liking videos or simple tasks.
2. You are asked to pay to “unlock” your earnings or reach the next level.
3. Each payment is bigger than the last, often to a different account.
4. Then they disappear with the money. Your earnings were never real.
